lines.text: A large fire has broken out in a multi-story building, with multiple fire trucks and emergency responders on the scene. The building is surrounded by smoke and flames, and several fire trucks are extended with ladders to the building's windows and balconies. There are many firefighters and paramedics present, working to extinguish the fire and provide medical assistance. The scene is chaotic and intense, with lights flashing and sirens blaring.
